title: Levi's Men's Quilted Hooded Bomber, Navy (S)

comparisons.notes: Men's Levi's Quilted Midweight Coat, style LM5RP520, navy in stock online at $99.99 (M, L, XL); same hooded quilted style as the Woot bomber

writeup: Levi's LM5RP520 quilted hooded bomber in navy, men's size small, is $37.99 on Woot. It has a drawstring hood and ribbed cuffs. Boscov's sells the same quilted style in navy for $99.99, and Kohl's lists it at $96 but is sold out, so this is about 62% less. Woot shows 7 left with a limit of 10 per customer.
